children.heading: Passenger motor vehicle.—
children.text: The term “passenger motor vehicle” has the meaning given that term in section 32101.

children.heading: Rear-designated seating position.—
children.text: The term “rear-designated seating position” means designated seating positions that are rearward of the front seat.

children.heading: Secretary.—
children.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Transportation.

tree.heading: Rulemaking.—
tree.text: Not later than 2 years after the date of enactment of this section, the Secretary shall issue a final rule requiring all new passenger motor vehicles weighing less than 10,000 pounds gross vehicle weight to be equipped with a system to alert the operator to check rear-designated seating positions after the vehicle engine or motor is deactivated by the operator.

children.text: shall include a distinct auditory and visual alert, which may be combined with a haptic alert; and
shall be activated when the vehicle motor is deactivated by the operator.

tree.heading: Phase-in.—
tree.text: The rule issued pursuant to subsection (b) shall require full compliance with the rule beginning on September 1st of the first calendar year that begins 2 years after the date on which the final rule is issued.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The date of enactment of this section, referred to in subsec. (b), is the date of enactment of Pub. L. 117–58, which was approved Nov. 15, 2021.
